mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a -2% YoY drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point increase over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating that the labor market deterioration is not impacting consumer behavior.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate, defined as a 50 basis point increase over the past 3 months, signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances following a 50bp hike in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year growth above 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Leading economic indicators (LEI) index declines by > 1% during the signal period, indicating a looming demand slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows year-over-year growth above 1.5%, it signals a tight labor market that will put upward pressure on wages and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average hourly earnings (AHETPI) growth slows by > 0.5pp YoY during the signal period, indicating that the tight labor market is not translating into wage pressure.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real yields on 10-year TIPS fall below 0% during the signal period, indicating that the restrictive monetary policy is not effectively combating inflation expectations.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) shows a year-over-year decline of more than 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM Manufacturing PMI rises above 50 during the signal period, indicating that the supply-driven slowdown is not broadly impacting the industrial sector.
